item.title: Sassy Shailene Woodley Interview 'Well You Should Probably Eat' A Growing Meme On X
item.description: Well You Should Probably Eat is a quote spoken by actress Shailene Woodley to interviewer Jamie Lee on the red carpet of the 2014 MTV Movie Awards after the interviewer tells Woodley that she's hungry. The interview was uploaded to the Pete Holmes YouTube channel in April 2014 and the clip of Woodley's response went viral over the following years, inspiring memes, including reaction images based on a screenshot of the interview and a phrasal template where "eat" is replaced with another verb as
